title: Kerala Natanam :: Classical Dance :: Online Classes. Prof. S. Lekha Thankachy H.O.D in Dance (RTD.)

The teacher explains that the course covers everything from basic steps to advanced techniques.
The teacher explains the logistics of her online classes, including how she provides feedback on student progress.
The teacher explains the meaning of the word 'Kala' (art).
The teacher shares her personal journey and passion for dance.
The teacher performs a dance sequence in a garden setting.

metaphors: Kala means the dissolution of all things into the ocean of art.
